scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='NEMOSA'; const out='dist'; fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})) { const s=path.join(src, entry.name); const d=path.join(out, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) fs.cpSync(s, d, {recursive:true}); else fs.copyFileSync(s, d); }"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd NEMOSA && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --project task-management-5d376
scripts.dev: npm run build && cd NEMOSA && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:start --only hosting
